text:
Clara M.: Asteria Health just submitted a vendor security checklist + DPA extras. They specifically ask for: SOC2 Type II cert, controls mapping, simplified dataflow, embeddings retention & deletion SOP, evidence of KMS/BYOK support or attestation, subprocessor list, and 90-day redacted access logs. Renewal alert = 6 weeks. Who can own compiling a customer-ready packet?
Derek (CS): I can take point. Quick Q: do they want full SOC2 or just the cert + mapping?
Priya (LegalOps): Only cert + mapping. If they insist on the full report require an executed NDA and purpose limitation. Also avoid sharing raw vulnerability findings.
Omar (Security): For KMS/BYOK: Hosted plans use cloud-provider-managed keys. We can provide a formal attestation stating that. Dedicated/private can be configured for customer-managed keys/HSM. I'll draft the attestation language.
Juno (Infra): I can pull access logs for tenant asteria-99 but will need exact tenant identifiers and approval for redaction. Expect 48-72h for redacted bundle. Follow redaction playbook: https://confluence.redwood/security/redaction
Clara M.: Tenant id = asteria-99. Derek, please coordinate and collect the exact artifact list. Make a Drive folder for artifacts.
Derek (CS): Plan: 1) SOC2 cert (PDF) + control mapping CSV, 2) dataflow PNG (simplified), 3) KMS attestation (Omar), 4) embeddings retention + deletion SOP excerpt, 5) subprocessor list, 6) redacted access logs (Juno), 7) short cover note for customer (Priya to review). Target internal review in 48h, customer send in 72h.
sec-bot: Reminder: redact PII and ticket IDs. Attach a redaction manifest with logs.
Omar (Security): Draft attestation I'll use: "Redwood Inference uses cloud-provider-managed CMKs for Hosted deployments. We do not permit customer-supplied key material on Hosted. Dedicated deployments support BYOK/HSM integrations subject to contract." Will post draft shortly.
Priya (LegalOps): Sample cover note: "Attached: SOC2 Type II certificate and a controls-to-product mapping. Per our policy we do not distribute full SOC2 reports without an NDA. See the attached attestation describing encryption and key management options. For BYOK requirements, please indicate if you are evaluating Dedicated or Private deployment so we can introduce Sales and Solutions Engineering"
Derek (CS): Adding a quick control mapping snippet to the Drive: ```ControlID,Control summary,Product area,evidence
CC2,Logical access,AuthN/AuthZ,auth-access-mapping.csv
CC5,Backup & retention,Embeddings store + S3 lifecycle,embeddings-retention.md
CC6,Change mgmt,CI/CD pipeline,deploy-audit.csv
```
Juno (Infra): Logs request logged: LOG-10877. I'll queue redaction and add manifest to Drive when complete.
Clara M.: Marking renewal risk = medium-high if they insist on BYOK for Hosted. Derek, escalate to Sales if they push BYOK.
Derek (CS): Will do. Creating Drive folder now: /Shared/CS/Asteria_4467890123_DPA_packet/ and assigning owners on the ticket. cs-bot: New ticket CS-5412 created and assigned to Derek (CS) due in 3 business days.
Priya (LegalOps): One more: ask whether embeddings contain PHI. If yes, include pseudonymization and deletion evidence in the packet.
Derek (CS): I'll confirm with their compliance contact in the intake form and post back. Closing for now; will reopen if blockers appear. :white_check_mark:
